model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots, each showing training rewards over steps for different models on distinct training sets. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps", which ranges from 0 to 500 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set", displays two lines: a teal line labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and a red line labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy". Both lines start at approximately 0.0, rise to a peak around 0.15–0.20 between 100 and 200 steps, and then gradually decline with some fluctuations, ending near 0.10–0.12 at 500 steps. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set", also shows two lines: a teal line labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and a red line labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard". The teal line starts at 0.0, rises to a peak of about 0.10 around 100 steps, and then drops sharply to near 0.0 by 200 steps, remaining flat thereafter. The red line starts at 0.0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.12 around 100 steps, then fluctuates downward with some oscillations, ending near 0.05 at 500 steps. Both plots include shaded regions around the lines, indicating uncertainty or standard deviation.
